subject: NYC SupperBoard — final guest list & venue contract
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: NYC SupperBoard — proposed venue shortlist & NDA ask

Hey team,

Per our planning call, here are three venue options for the June executive supperboard in NYC (20 pax, private dining, AV minimal):

- Brixton House (Chelsea) — private dining room, vendor catering allowed, cable mic available. Quote attached.
- The Larkin Club — higher per-head, but great privacy and valet.
- Rooftop at The Meridian — weather backup needed; smaller footprint.

Ask: can Legal review Brixton House contract (they offered a standard event agreement) and confirm whether our standard NDA needs to be sent to invitees before confirmations? We have a couple of prospect execs from FinTechCorp who prefer pre-event NDA.

Attached: venue estimates and a draft NDA we typically use.

Next steps I propose: choose venue by Tuesday (5/26), start sending save-the-dates, and finalize guest list v2.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Events & Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
--Attachment: brixton_estimate_2026-05-24.pdf (pdf)
--Attachment: nda_template_redwood.docx (docx)

Subject: Re: NYC SupperBoard — proposed venue shortlist & NDA ask

Thanks Marissa — quick notes:

- Brixton House seems the best balance of privacy and price. Leaning that direction.
- Guest vetting: please ensure we have company title/area for each invitee; prioritize CPO/CIO-level prospects and top 6 customers for upsell.
- For FinTechCorp execs, yes, get NDA signed pre-event. Also confirm whether marketing can share attendee list with sponsors (they said no).

Can you start a consolidated guest_list_master_v3.xlsx and flag the NDA-required guests? Vanessa — can you help with the transportation/block hotel asks? I can approve the venue choice once Legal confirms contract redlines.

Marcus

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T15:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Brixton House contract (please review)

Thanks for the ping — quick read below.

1) Indemnity: narrow to third-party claims arising from our negligence; strike vendor-favorable blanket indemnity.
2) Force Majeure: remove pandemic-specific long-tail cancellation fee; allow for mutually agreed rescheduling within 6 months.
3) Cancellation: push for 14-day modest fee for deposits rather than 30-day full penalty.

I attached a redline summary in comments (short bullets) and our standard NDA language — for the FinTechCorp execs we can send the NDA ahead of the event; marketing should register the executed NDAs in the event folder.

If Brixton agrees to those three, Marcus can approve booking. If they refuse, I recommend The Larkin as backup.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Counsel
Redwood Inference

--Attachment: contract_redlines_brixton_comments.pdf (pdf)
--Attachment: nda_template_redwood.docx (docx)

From: Events Team <events@brixtonhouse.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: events@brixtonhouse.com
Date: 2026-05-28T10:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Brixton House — event agreement (draft)

Hi Laura / Marcus,

Thanks for the redlines — we can accept the limited indemnity language and amend the force majeure to allow a single reschedule within 6 months. Regarding cancellation, we can move to a 21-day reduced fee (standard for summer bookings).

I have uploaded the amended contract to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/supersign/3f7a2b and cc'd our operations manager to expedite. Let us know if you need any additional insurance certificates; we can provide them.

Best,
Alex from Brixton Events
--Attachment: brixton_amended_contract_signed.pdf (pdf)

Guest list (attached): final 20 names flagged — three guests require NDA before receiving invite (two prospects from FinTechCorp and one partner contact at Brightwell). Marissa, please send NDA packets to the three flagged contacts and confirm when signed. Vanessa, please confirm hotel blocks and town car pickup for C-levels (use corporate rate).

Logistics checklist:

- Menu: family-style tasting (Marissa to finalize).
- AV: cable mic + minimal laptop deck.
- Parking: valet reserved (5 spots).

Thanks team — once NDAs are in we'll send formal calendar invites and meal preferences.

Marcus Lin
